mapper.sql: a.ADVANCE_ID, a.ADVANCE_NO, a.CUSTOMER_ID, a.ADVANCE_AMOUNT, a.OFFSET_AMOUNT, a.REMAINING_AMOUNT, a.ADVANCE_STATUS, a.ADVANCE_DATE, a.PAYMENT_METHOD, a.BANK_NAME, a.BANK_ACCOUNT, a.REMARKS, a.TENANT_ID, a.ORG_ID, a.CREATE_TIME, a.CREATE_BY, a.UPDATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_BY, a.IS_DELETED
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_AR_ADVANCE_RECEIPT a WHERE a.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND a.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND a.ADVANCE_STATUS IN (0, 1) AND a.REMAINING_AMOUNT > 0 AND a.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY a.ADVANCE_DATE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_AR_ADVANCE_RECEIPT SET OFFSET_AMOUNT = OFFSET_AMOUNT + #{amount}, REMAINING_AMOUNT = REMAINING_AMOUNT - #{amount}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ADVANCE_ID = #{advanceId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
